caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top and four elaborately turned legs, all rendered in shades of brown. The table features two drawers at the front, each fitted with a brass-colored handle. The bottom of the drawers is bordered by a scalloped apron. The legs are connected by horizontal wooden stretchers, forming a rectangular support structure near the base. The table stands on a plain background with a light beige color, and there are no additional objects or elements surrounding the table. The illustration is executed with attention to wood texture and grain, highlighting the table's construction and joinery.
title: Table
